description: This file contains test utilities for Kubernetes, including fake implementations of node handlers, event recorders, and helper functions for creating test nodes and pods. It is used for unit testing Kubernetes controllers and components.

classes.name: FakeNodeHandler
classes.description: A fake implementation of node interface for testing, allowing control over node operations such as create, get, list, update, delete, and patch.

classes.name: FakeLegacyHandler
classes.description: A fake implementation of CoreV1Interface that provides access to the FakeNodeHandler.

classes.name: FakeRecorder
classes.description: A fake event recorder for testing event emission in Kubernetes components.

methods.name: GetUpdatedNodesCopy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the list of updated nodes.

methods.name: Core
methods.description: Returns the fake CoreV1Interface.

methods.name: CoreV1
methods.description: Returns the fake CoreV1Interface.

methods.name: Nodes
methods.description: Returns the fake NodeInterface.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new node in the fake store.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a node by name from the fake store.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all nodes in the fake store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a node by ID from the fake store.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a node in the fake store.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a node.

methods.name: PatchStatus
methods.description: Patches the status of a node.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches nodes for changes.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Patches a node with given patch data.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a NodeApplyConfiguration to a node.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a NodeApplyConfiguration to a node's status.

methods.name: Event
methods.description: Emits an event.

methods.name: Eventf
methods.description: Emits a formatted event.

methods.name: AnnotatedEventf
methods.description: Emits an annotated formatted event.

methods.name: generateEvent
methods.description: Generates and records an event.

methods.name: makeEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event object.

methods.name: NewFakeRecorder
methods.description: Creates a new fake event recorder.

methods.name: NewNode
methods.description: Creates a new test node.

methods.name: NewPod
methods.description: Creates a new test pod.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a node exists in a list of nodes.

methods.name: GetZones
methods.description: Returns list of zones for all nodes.

methods.name: CreateZoneID
methods.description: Creates a zone ID string from region and zone.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key for a Kubernetes resource object.
